device.deviceName: Room in the Cart iOS 17 Small

title: Test - RoomInTheCart
provenance: Built from .build/AccessibilityCandidateSnapshot with the two tested files subsequently copied byte-for-byte to shared source. Other concurrent development was outside this build.
initialFailure: The labeled switch row was tapped at (187.5, 411.75) pt on iOS 17. The native switch remained off. The passing test locates the nested native switch and verifies both states.
productRegression: On iOS 17, tapping the prepared preview label triggered competing automatic Form-row actions. The run logged “Attempting to export a nil document” and the prepared controls disappeared. Independent Form rows allow the preview to expand and keep the export until explicit discard.
